# Story 01 — View and Update User Profile (Story: STORY-009)

## Prerequisites

- Story for `auth/user-login` completed (JWT issuance, `ApplicationUser` accessible via `ICurrentUserService`). Coordinate with the owner of the login story to reuse the `ICurrentUserService` contract at `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/Common/Interfaces/ICurrentUserService.cs` and the authenticated pipeline configured in `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.API/Extensions/JwtAuthenticationExtensions.cs`.
- Story for `auth/change-password` is **not** a blocker but overlaps — do **not** expose password/credential fields via the profile endpoints in this story.
- Frontend `AuthProvider` at `src/FrontEnd/src/features/auth/context/AuthProvider.tsx` and API client at `src/FrontEnd/src/lib/api/apiClient.ts` are available.

---

## Story Goal

Give any authenticated user (Customer, Agent, Supervisor, Administrator) the ability to **view and update only their own profile** through the API and the SPA.

In scope (user-visible outcomes):

1. `GET /api/users/me` returns the caller's profile (name, email, phone) — **no** password hash, security stamps, tokens, lockout, or role assignments.
2. `PUT /api/users/me` updates the caller's editable profile fields (first name, last name, phone number, email) with validation, and returns the updated profile.
3. Invalid input (e.g. malformed email, empty required fields) is rejected with structured field-level validation errors matching the pattern used by `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.API/Filters/ValidationFilter.cs`.
4. The endpoint **cannot** target another user; the identity always comes from the JWT via `ICurrentUserService`.
5. A frontend "My Profile" page renders the profile, allows edits, and persists them via the new endpoints.

Out of scope: password change, email confirmation re-flow (if email changes, mark `EmailConfirmed = false` and note follow-up TODO), role/permission edits, admin management of other users.

### 2 — Validator

**Create file:** `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/Features/Users/Validators/UpdateUserProfileRequestValidator.cs`

```csharp
using FluentValidation;
using CustomerSupportCRM.Application.Features.Users.DTOs;

namespace CustomerSupportCRM.Application.Features.Users.Validators;

public sealed class UpdateUserProfileRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateUserProfileRequest>
{
    public UpdateUserProfileRequestValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.FirstName).MaximumLength(100);
        RuleFor(x => x.LastName).MaximumLength(100);
        RuleFor(x => x.Email)
            .EmailAddress().When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Email))
            .MaximumLength(256);
        RuleFor(x => x.PhoneNumber)
            .Matches(@"^\+?[0-9\s\-()]{6,20}$")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.PhoneNumber));
    }
}
```

Registration: verify `AddValidatorsFromAssembly(...)` is already called in `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/DependencyInjection.cs`; if it is, no extra wiring is needed. Otherwise add `services.AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining<UpdateUserProfileRequestValidator>()` there.

**Create file:** `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Infrastructure/Identity/Services/UserProfileService.cs`

- Injects `UserManager<ApplicationUser>` and `ICurrentUserService`.
- `GetCurrentAsync`: resolves the caller id from `ICurrentUserService`; if null/empty throw `UnauthorizedException` (`src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Domain/Exceptions/UnauthorizedException.cs`). `UserManager.FindByIdAsync`; if null throw `NotFoundException`. - `UpdateCurrentAsync`: fetch same user. For each non-null field, set the corresponding property. When `Email` changes and differs (case-insensitive), call `UserManager.SetEmailAsync` and `UserManager.SetUserNameAsync` if userName mirrors email in this project (verify in `ApplicationUser.cs`) and set `EmailConfirmed = false` (leave a `// TODO: trigger email re-verification (auth/email-verification story)` comment). When `PhoneNumber` changes call `UserManager.SetPhoneNumberAsync`. Otherwise `UserManager.UpdateAsync`. Aggregate any `IdentityResult` errors into a `ValidationException` (`src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/Common/Exceptions/ValidationException.cs`).
- Return the freshly-mapped `UserProfileDto`.

### 5 — Controller

**Create file:** `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.API/Controllers/UsersController.cs`

```csharp
using CustomerSupportCRM.Application.Features.Users.DTOs;
using CustomerSupportCRM.Application.Features.Users.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace CustomerSupportCRM.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/users")]
[Authorize]
public sealed class UsersController : BaseApiController
{
    private readonly IUserProfileService _userProfileService;

    public UsersController(IUserProfileService userProfileService)
        => _userProfileService = userProfileService;

    [HttpGet("me")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(UserProfileDto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserProfileDto>> GetMe(CancellationToken ct)
        => Ok(await _userProfileService.GetCurrentAsync(ct));

    [HttpPut("me")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(UserProfileDto), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
    public async Task<ActionResult<UserProfileDto>> UpdateMe(
        [FromBody] UpdateUserProfileRequest request,
        CancellationToken ct)
        => Ok(await _userProfileService.UpdateCurrentAsync(request, ct));
}
```

Do **not** add any route accepting a `{userId}` — self-service only. Admin management is out of scope.

If `ApplicationUser` needs a new column (e.g. `PhoneNumber` — verify via the entity file), that is a separate concern; prefer to reuse existing Identity columns.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Unauthenticated call** → controller's `[Authorize]` returns `401`. Verified by `JwtAuthenticationExtensions.cs`.
- **Missing/invalid `sub` claim on token** → `ICurrentUserService.UserId` is null → service throws `UnauthorizedException`, translated by `GlobalExceptionHandler` (`src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.API/Middlewares/GlobalExceptionHandler.cs`).
- **User row deleted while token still valid** → `UserManager.FindByIdAsync` returns null → `NotFoundException` → 404 via `GlobalExceptionHandler`.
- **Email already taken by another user** → `UserManager.SetEmailAsync` returns `IdentityResult` with `DuplicateEmail`; convert to `ValidationException` with field key `email`.
- **Empty body / all-null fields on PUT** → validator passes, service becomes a no-op update and returns current profile unchanged. Acceptable.
- **Attempt to change email to same value (different casing)** → normalise via `UserManager.NormalizeEmail`; skip the `SetEmailAsync` call if unchanged (avoids clearing `EmailConfirmed`).
- **Unicode / RTL characters in name fields** → validator only enforces length; allow. Frontend must render correctly in Arabic via existing `I18nProvider`.
- **Concurrency** — Identity uses a `ConcurrencyStamp`. On `DbUpdateConcurrencyException`, translate to HTTP 409 (add mapping in `GlobalExceptionHandler` if not already present; otherwise let it bubble as 500 and note as follow-up).
- **Cross-user access attempt** — There is deliberately no `{userId}` route parameter; the id is derived from the token so this cannot happen through this endpoint. Explicit test asserts this.
- **Malformed JSON** → 400 handled by ASP.NET Core model binder.

## Migration / Rollback

- **DB migrations:** none. This story only reads/writes existing `AspNetUsers` columns.
- **Rollback:** revert the new controller, service, DTOs, validator, mapping profile, and the DI registration line added in `Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs`. Remove the `/profile` route and menu item on the frontend.
- **Half-applied state:** if the backend is deployed without the frontend, no user impact (endpoint is opt-in). If the frontend is deployed without the backend, `ProfilePage` will render an error state via `normalizeApiError`; acceptable.
